notes.stt: Delivery equity 0.1% buy and sell; equity ETF units 0.001% on sale only; non-equity ETFs nil. NSE: https://www.nseindia.com/static/invest/first-time-investor-sebi-turnover-fees-stt-other-levies
notes.stamp_buy: 0.015% on delivery purchases, paid by buyer (Indian Stamp Act amendment, 1 July 2020). Source as above.
notes.exchange: NSE cash-market transaction charge 0.00297% (uniform rate). Verify on the NSE charges page before submission.
notes.sebi: SEBI turnover fee Rs 10 per crore.
notes.gst: 18% on brokerage, exchange and SEBI fees.
notes.dp_charge_per_sell: Depository + broker DP charge per scrip per sell day, incl. GST (typical discount broker). Verify for the broker you describe.
notes.flat_fee: Rs 20 per executed order (typical discount broker intraday/F&O fee; several brokers charge it on delivery too).
notes.half_spread: Assumed half bid-ask spread; robustness adds 10/25/50 bps.

notes.equity: Stocks and equity ETFs: STCG 20% (Sec 111A) if held <= 12 months; LTCG 12.5% above Rs 1.25 lakh per FY aggregate (Sec 112A). ClearTax: https://cleartax.in/s/how-are-etfs-taxed
notes.gold_intl: Gold and international ETFs: STCG at slab rate (<= 12 months); LTCG 12.5% without indexation, no Rs 1.25 lakh exemption. IIFL: https://www.iifl.com/blogs/gold-loan/gold-etf-tax-in-india-2026-post-finance-act-2024-rules
notes.debt: Debt ETFs bought on/after 1 April 2023: slab rate regardless of holding period (Sec 50AA). Finnovate: https://www.finnovate.in/learn/blog/etf-taxation-india
notes.unchanged_2026: Structure set by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 and unchanged in Budget 2026. https://finlecture.in/indian-tax-system/capital-gains-tax-fy-2026-27/
notes.historical_regime: Robustness only: equity LTCG exempt before 1-Apr-2018, 10% above Rs 1 lakh until 22-Jul-2024 with 31-Jan-2018 grandfathering; equity STCG 15% until 22-Jul-2024; non-equity LTCG 20% with indexation after 36 months for sales before 23-Jul-2024; Sec 50AA slab taxation for units bought from 1-Apr-2023 (gold/international until 31-Mar-2025). CII values should be verified against CBDT notifications.
notes.simplifications: Resident individual; 4% cess; no surcharge; tax paid each July from the portfolio; losses set off and carried forward; dividends ignored (growth ETFs).
